normalisation: Fixed journal/render inputs have no normalization; all state, reason, usage quantity and provenance bytes are retained.
Run refusal replaces only event_id evt_ULID, producer_id cli_ULID and observed_at timestamp tokens in the original JSON bytes; all field names, order, presence, types and result values remain exact.

Demo uses --after 1 to omit the timing-dependent initial summary and resume at event 2; fixed journal review/render captures cover initial summary and created event. Events 2 through 23 and next-after: 23 must all remain.

Demo replaces exact generated repository/state paths, including a width-truncated workspace path only after checking it is a prefix of that exact workspace. Path separators change only inside generated evidence paths.
Demo generated run and attempt ULIDs use injective per-role first-occurrence names; distinct worker/native PIDs use role names. Changing a repeated identity to a different identity remains visible.

Demo full base/candidate Git references and their known display/path prefixes are replaced consistently, only after real Git base-to-candidate changed paths equal demo.txt and candidate demo.txt equals ok plus newline. The full diff, fixed evidence digest, result, verification and provenance stay exact. Git strips inherited GIT_* dates, so environment cannot fix commit timestamps.

A bounded slow-consumer writer waits at event 4 until receipt.written exists in the synthetic journal. This controls source timing without changing runtime code; it does not fix or qualify the unsynchronized terminal-watch race that can omit event 23.
